BiblicalUsage: Omen means verity, truth, faithfulness. It occurs once, in Isaiah 25:1, where the prophet says the Lord's counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the counsels of God are faithful and true, and the plans He made of old are the plans He keeps.
